title: Promethei Bibliotheca
physical_identity: Elegant marble/granite library with tuff pillars, Renaissance-style paintings, countless randomly assorted books; a sub-section of the Terror Hotel (Level 5).
scale_topology: Infinitely long corridors but only seven floors joined by wooden staircases; indoor; corridor edge opens to a void with iron bars.
anomalies: steals memories after ~1-2 hours and writes them into books
conscious Library Mind communicates through induced emotions
lighting_sound: not stated (no lighting or sound described); dust-covered, pristine books.

entities.name: Library Mind
entities.behavior: Bodiless consciousness; extracts memories, signals via emotion, drops books or collapses shelves in anger

entities.name: The Gentleman / Beast of Level 5
entities.behavior: Appears only in an exit vignette; hostile to the library; leaves

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Library Mind (bodiless); Gentleman only as narrative vignette
hazards: memory loss with headaches after 1-2 hours
bookshelf collapse when Mind is angry
items_communities: M.E.G. base Housekeeping nearby on Level 5
Hermes team of Ariane Circle has an agreement

entrances.method: old wooden door at end of newly discovered corridor
entrances.conditions: may be unreliable due to non-euclidean Level 5
entrances.quote: only known entrance to the Promethean Library is in a newly discovered corridor

exits.method: wooden door at a dead-end corridor
exits.conditions: only a chance a corridor ends this way
exits.quote: a chance that a corridor will lead to a dead end with a wooden door

signature_mechanic: Timed memory extraction: after ~1-2 hours the library strips memories into books; seekers trade memory for knowledge.
verticality: Seven floors connected by wooden staircases; edge corridors open onto a void.
conflicts_notes: Exit text says door returns to library entrance, ambiguous; footnotes absent from snapshot; chats are testimony. Gentleman scene is narrative.

key_quotes.quote: hundreds of corridors stretching on all sides
infinitely long corridors, it only has seven floors
it is highly advised not to remain in the Promethean Library for more than an hour
There is a chance that a corridor will lead to a dead end with a wooden door on the wall.
